entities.name: courses
entities.purpose: Course identity and display metadata; names/order are editable.

entities.name: chapters
entities.purpose: Interaction-based chapter names and order from the active curriculum.

entities.name: units
entities.purpose: Stable identity, aliases and chapter/order metadata. Requirements and provided skills are authoritative in each immutable unit revision, not independently edited copies.

entities.name: unit_revisions
entities.purpose: Validated authoring payload including answer keys and review metadata. Raw payload is never learner-readable. Published revisions and referenced assets are immutable.

entities.name: media_assets
entities.purpose: Immutable versioned approved file identities and checksums. Runtime resolves protected HTTPS URLs; local paths never become runtime URLs.

entities.name: user_unit_progress
entities.purpose: Pinned revision and activity boundary, scenario position, assistance and evidence. Viewed, correct, correct_with_help, self_compared and scenario_completed are distinct; self_compared is not pronunciation correctness.

entities.name: activity_attempts
entities.purpose: Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated user across all units. Same request and fingerprint returns stored result; changed input conflicts. Never store auth tokens or learner audio here.

entities.name: chapter_releases
entities.purpose: Immutable approved release snapshot with one active published release per chapter. Staging is invisible to learners.

entities.name: chapter_release_units
entities.purpose: Exact ordered membership of a complete chapter, pointing to the reviewed unit revisions and media digest.

access.identity: Google and Apple via Supabase Auth; no guest or anonymous learning.
access.content: Authenticated read of published runtime projections; drafts and answer keys are not learner-readable.
access.progress: Own SELECT uses TO authenticated plus auth.uid()=user_id. No anon/authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on progress or attempts. Service-only RPC may submit validated attempts; a verified user identity is supplied by NestJS, never by the mobile body.
access.publish: Only the trusted importer/server publishes approved content. Privileged keys never enter the mobile application.
access.storage: Auth-protected approved lesson assets; persistent learner recording archives are not selected.
access.verification: Policies, foreign keys, indexes and access tests still need implementation in stage04; this file grants no access.
access.raw_authoring: No anon/authenticated SELECT of unit_revisions authoring_payload or raw release review evidence; runtime access goes through an allowlisted NestJS projection.
access.atomic_submission: SECURITY INVOKER database function callable only by the trusted server role; revoke default PUBLIC/anon/authenticated EXECUTE. Service-role access can bypass RLS: the function and NestJS must explicitly enforce user ownership, state, revision, response membership and allowed transitions. Do not fix permissions by adding SECURITY DEFINER.

revisionRules.renaming: Stable IDs survive title and chapter-order changes.
revisionRules.resume: Resume uses the user's pinned published revision and stable activity ID. Published revisions referenced by progress are retained.
revisionRules.newStart: New starts use the latest published revision; drafts are excluded.
revisionRules.completion: Old completion records remain historical evidence; new revision mastery is not inferred.
revisionRules.publication: Use the whole-chapter checker plus content/media digests and human evidence; only whole approved releases become readable.
revisionRules.skills: Unlock based on own completed exact revisions and the skills declared there; never infer newly introduced skills from an old completion. Skill gating is separate from development order.
revisionRules.resume_boundary: Restore activity and scenario node, not audio playback second or interrupted recording.

implementationBoundary: No cloud project, SQL migration, importer, API endpoint or user-data operation is created by this design. Read current Supabase docs and create versioned migrations during stage04.
constraints_and_indexes: Primary/foreign keys as listed; revisions positive, progress_version nonnegative.
Unique (user_id, request_id) on attempts; unique (user_id, unit_id, revision) on progress.
Partial unique (user_id, unit_id) where status=in_progress; start serialized per user/unit to avoid duplicate active starts.
Index chapter_release_units(unit_id,revision) and units(chapter_id); progress primary-key prefix supports own-unit lookup. Add no JSONB index without a measured query.
Activity/node IDs live inside revision JSONB; the atomic write validates their membership and the allowed transition. A relational foreign key to an activity table is not claimed.
Published payloads/releases/media cannot be overwritten. Retain referenced revisions and files; rollback changes the active release pointer to a previous whole snapshot.

atomic_operations.start: In a short transaction serialize the user/unit, resume its active pinned revision; otherwise check skills from own completed exact revisions and choose the latest published accessible release. Repeated starts return the existing record; same completed revision returns completion.
atomic_operations.submit: Authenticate outside the transaction. Inside one transaction serialize the user/unit, look up (user_id,request_id) first, compare canonical request fingerprint, validate pinned revision/activity/node and expected progress_version, compute/validate the authoritative transition from immutable content, then insert attempt and update progress together. No HTTP/audio calls while holding a database lock.
atomic_operations.publish: Validate schema/skills/review/file checksums before staging; inside one transaction verify immutable identities, insert complete release membership and activate the whole release. Failure leaves the prior whole release active. Importer retry uses manifest_digest; never exposes staged units.
atomic_operations.verification_boundary: These are migration/API requirements for04/05. Local pure tests do not prove PostgreSQL atomicity, unique constraints, RLS, real JWT validation or parallel network behavior.

privacy.learner_audio: Local transient recording/self-playback only; not in JSON, requests, attempt history or Storage. Microphone-free comparison available. Clear transient recording on exit/sign-out.
privacy.pending_request: One current unacknowledged attempt, stored locally and scoped to user_id; no tokens/audio. Do not advance until server acknowledgement. Restore/retry with the same request_id. A different signed-in user cannot restore it. Clear local pending data on sign-out; acknowledged server progress remains authoritative.

workflow_decisions.development: Finish planning, implementation and testing for all C01 before planning/implementing C02. Weekly launch target is both complete opening chapters.
workflow_decisions.learning: Codex implements and explains; Dor reviews behavior and performs meaningful checks. Record execution and demonstrated understanding separately.
